title: The “Trump Put” Gets Exercised Again.
summary: sToday was a “rip-up-the script” day. A headline that says “Nasdaq 100 Pares Gains to 7%” is prima facie evidence of that. My original intention today was to unpack Friday’s meltdown and to discuss questions about whether we might be nearing the unknown strike price of the “Fed Put.” Instead, we discovered that the “Trump Put” was struck at roughly 90% moneyness when the administration acknowledged that it was behind Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA). It was clearly done to arrest the market selloff.
